ineligibility_ci1.note: descriptive; the pilot attaches no decision rule and 24 draws cannot establish a proportion to the confirmatory design's precision

labelled_fraction_at_enrolment.meaning: matter and cohort are BOTH exactly conserved, so this lattice-wide ratio is fixed for the whole run; under complete mixing every local residual tends to it, and every frozen convention (0.01, 0.05, 0.20) lies far below it

summary.sensitivity_matrix_status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.  The frozen specification is threshold=0.45, min_cells=3, and its row is the primary result.  No cell of this matrix is selected, and the matrix is reported whole.

wrapping_onset_at_frozen_spec.reading: if most worlds do NOT wrap at enrolment but ALL wrap later, the percolating component is produced by the dynamics, not by the initial-condition law
